# C09 — Diaphaneity

## #0

Diaphaneity is the capacity of a determination to disclose its mediation: what appears can be read together with the position, means and conditions through which it appears. The medium's shaping role becomes visible in what it lets through. Its disappearance would remove the very relation that has become intelligible.

The [determination and its determining condition](C05-Immutable-Gap.md) remain non-coincident: making a condition explicit produces another determination, through a present seeing that has not become the object it presents. [Contextual transparency](../A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) makes this relation readable in both directions. A situated self sees a world; the disclosed world also shows the situation of that self. Increasing the readability changes what can be known and done through the mediation while retaining the difference through which it operates.

## #1

Perspective renders a world from a position. Its achievement includes determinate depth, proportion and a field that can be communicated. Its conditions can nevertheless disappear behind the scene it renders. Adding more detail to the scene does not necessarily reveal that disappearance.

In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin|Gebser's account of landscape and perspectival optics]], a positioned ego-world becomes visible through changes in the means of rendering it. Aperspectivity releases perspective from exclusive validity while retaining its achievement. A view can therefore remain exact without making its own angle the limit of what can appear. The contemporary contextual turn makes that angle and the other conditions of seeing available within the view they form.

**A report of experience is first a psychic fact before it is assigned a final causal or ontological explanation.** Ordinary and extraordinary, natural and reported-as-supernatural experience can therefore enter the field without being screened out because one register already knows what another is allowed to say. The experience, its symbolic articulation, its historical comparanda, its bodily or physical conditions and its metaphysical interpretation remain distinct claims. Diaphaneity makes those relations readable together; it does not collapse their warrants.

## #2

A contextual reading is involved in what it sees. Taylor's being with the text and subtext makes embodied participation and care for the situation's outcome active in seeing. All such contexts are themselves contextualised by the encompassing round of Unitary Being, the Rotundum. Its ultimate contextualising is a-contextual: it does not come from one more limited perspective or an aggregate of perspectives. Equanimous objectivity holds situated care within this encompassing condition. The involvement becomes readable and answerable without turning its unobjectifiable ground into an aloof observer installed beyond the encounter. Indifference leaves the observer's effects operative while making their participation harder to recognise.

Taylor's absent-Father image makes the pathology exact. An unavailable final standard remains active as a demand; a surrogate image can then occupy its office. Apparent aloofness becomes a way of ruling while disavowing participation. The ordering ground is appropriated by a ruler claiming to stand above its own law. This [usurpation of measure](../A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) turns a situated judgment into an apparently absolute standard. Reading the hidden position through its effects restores the judging office's relation to the ground and lives it cannot possess.

## #3

The stained-glass image gives the operation a whole body. Originating white light figures Bimba; its full ordered spectrum figures QL. Differently made and positioned panes, their densities, angles, colours and lead seams figure MEF's refracting apparatus. The coloured image cast into the room is Pratibimba. Recognition reads the one light through the lawful differences of the display.

The seams retain source distinctions and translation limits. The projected image changes with sun, pane, room and viewer. Its changes disclose relations that a single fixed view concealed. The Original is not an average of images or a final picture assembled from their sum. QL belongs to the light's internal order. Pane and lead form the refracting apparatus through which that order differentially appears.

[Lens-conditioned inquiry](C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) gives the refraction an epistemic operation: changing a lens changes a question, an admitted source, a distinction or a judgment, while the source differences remain available in the joins. A [world-atlas](../A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) coordinates differing views through their domains and transitions, retaining what each discloses and excludes. The coloured projection gives these relations a concrete body. Its optical transformations and the conscious appearing they make intelligible retain different registers; neither supplies the other’s formal proof.

## #4

In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/maroski/maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words/maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words#maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words-q002|Maroski's transparency distinction]], transparency concerns the form manifestation takes. What becomes readable is how the appearing comes to have this form; treating transparency as another object would conceal that relation again. Her companion seed/tree discussion preserves the co-presence of consciousness structures: a later articulation can make earlier capacities available within its development.

The first-, second- and third-person passage reaches context when their positions become jointly available. In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy|Taylor's personed recognition]], knower, means and known are first traversed in sequence. Their `180°→360°` turn voids each view's claim to exclusive completeness, recognises the three as one appearing-act and returns that achieved relation to its ground. The personed `AM/IS` situates this act within the whole eightfold: a capacity determines an instance in a Life, and the achieved determination can return upon its conditions. Context holds those positions together without adding a fourth pronoun or an observer outside all views.

Co-presence therefore operates across time as well as within a single context. A later structure does not erase earlier powers of image, myth, polarity or rational articulation; each can recur productively or pathologically within a present Life. The [tattvic differentiation of consciousness](../A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) follows its capacity to take form as a finite world. The [Indian advent of zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) distinguishes placeholder, numeral, arithmetic operation and later mathematical offices alongside the Kashmiri transcendental inquiry. Their particular histories make consciousness's self-differentiation and mathematical determination available together, while each relation keeps the sources and chronology through which it arose.

## #5→0

Through the [eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-regard-refraction), the viewer’s changed relation to the pane makes the means of seeing readable. Material, colour, seam and placement become available in what appears, and another view exposes an earlier occlusion. The returned difference can correct what was seen or disclose a failure of the criterion used to judge it. Keeping that criterion immune to challenge would leave the return unperformed; retaining a fitting criterion after considering the challenge carries a different, reasoned judgment into the next encounter.

A [travelling planetary picture](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge) retains its location, time, production and exclusions in use. Its breadth ceases to decide the authority of its account in advance. Whose planet is pictured, from which position and under what gauge becomes part of the account. The viewer becomes answerable within that disclosed relation; no particular photographic asset is established by the image’s developmental use.

In the [changing window](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-changing-context), sun, pane, room and viewer change together. The cast image makes the conditions of its predecessor readable. A changed position can reveal an occlusion; a changed pane can alter what the light makes available. Contextual transparency reaches the next judgement through these differences instead of producing an exhaustive picture by adding the projections.

In Taylor's [world-parent separation](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation), light, directions and boundaries become available together. The differentiated field discloses the conditions through which it appeared. The [circle-costume](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-position-opposition) closes that availability when one visible circumference becomes exhaustive of the creature. Mouth, depth and opening disclose what the governing outline excluded; recognition changes the relation to the same visible form.

For a technical account, visible output or execution logs are a beginning. An [inspectable judgment field](C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) distinguishes source, lens, evaluator, permission and exclusion within what is judged. The interpreting agent occupies the local functional knower office; retained reports, sources, rules and instruments are means; the claims and alternatives compared are known. Within the containing person’s inquiry, the complete apparatus serves as means. Its interpreting centre can itself become known in a further act, while the first-person condition of that inspection remains irreducible to the inspected account. Diaphaneity makes these relations available so a disclosed condition can bear on the next judgment.

The positive psychic-fact office is realised differently across the product field. Through [living articulation](../products/S1-Actuation.md), an experience or report becomes a consequential event. [Situated existence](../products/S4-Workcell.md) gives that event its aperture, temporal exposure and material resistance. [Transcendent Relation](../products/S5-Quaternal-Logic.md) keeps its differentiated accounts within their containing wholes. None of these offices decides in advance what an extraordinary report “really was.” The report, its conditions and its interpretations remain available for a return that can refine the next act of inquiry.

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Con-text-through-Diaphaneity]] makes the context visible through a determination. Regard becomes possible when the affected person, excluded source or returned consequence can reach the judging office. Their answer acquires a place from which it can alter the account. [Deferential intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) carries the judgment into action at the depth actually exposed: an answer, task, model, evaluator or commission can be corrected, or a fitting condition retained with reasons. The next act inherits that judgment. The [Context Frame](C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) becomes readable through its effects, available for warranted revision without claiming to own the whole from which it arose.
